reuse.why: Reuses withBankAccountGuard, linkSimpleFinAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions, but by bending provider-specific functions (a provider flag plus an after-the-fact sync-source overwrite) rather than extracting a provider-neutral link/download routine.

duplication.why: Avoids copying a sixth link function and download function; the only duplication is the provider branch inside linkSimpleFinAccount.

placement.why: Fintegra behaviour is hidden inside functions named for SimpleFin and Akahu, so provider logic lives in another provider's code.

scope.why: Mostly what the feature needs, plus a loosely related retyping of DbAccount.account_sync_source via an inline import().

maintainability.why: linkSimpleFinAccount writes 'simpleFin' then patches it to 'fintegra', and Akahu's downloader now serves another provider; changes to SimpleFin or Akahu silently affect Fintegra.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The link guard (withBankAccountGuard) and syncAccount dispatch are used.
